product_one_liner.value: Momentus provides venue and event management software that helps venue operators manage sales, bookings, event operations, billing and reporting in one platform.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes Momentus Enterprise and Momentus Elite offerings.

named_customers.notes: All three appear in the homepage's customer trust statement.

employee_band.notes: The company's LinkedIn page lists 201–500 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed index focuses on venue advice, product news and marketing; it did not establish two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: The public Momentus Elite support center includes documentation covering booking, contacts, event financials, operations and other product functions.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: None of the seven roles listed on the reviewed board has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.value: AWS Bedrock, providing access to foundation models from Anthropic, Meta, Amazon and Cohere.
model_provider.notes: Momentus says its engineering team selects models per task rather than relying on one exclusive provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Public claims include SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022 certification and PCI DSS SAQ D.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook lists the latest financing as January 5, 2026, with a size of USD 27.694 million. This is acquisition debt, not an equity round.

raised_18mo.notes: The financing record lists acquisition debt dated January 5, 2026, within the window. A separate public announcement or filing for this transaction was not located.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A SmartRecruiters posting advertises a full-time Account Executive role for EMEA.

launched_6mo.notes: On September 15, 2026, Momentus announced MomentusMAX and general availability of MAX for Sales.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Liz Bernardo's profile lists her start as Senior Vice President Marketing at Momentus Technologies in August 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Sales Operations Analyst posting identifies Salesforce as the primary platform and also names HubSpot and Gong.
